verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only hierarchical multi-agent composition, where a manager agent receives sub-agents through `managed_agents` and the LLM decides when to delegate. Nothing documents an explicit graph or workflow API with developer-defined branching, loops, or parallel steps. Step-by-step execution (`agent.step`) is a building block a developer could use to construct such control flow, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose agents into an explicit graph or workflow with branching, loops, and parallel steps
